notes.title: Troop Enhancement #4 - Hornet
notes.content:
Hello Commanders,

Today, I will be presenting the passive skills of the final minion type you will meet in this demo version of Warkestra, the Hornets.

As the only flying type minion in Warkestra, the Hornets' Passive skills largely focus on sleep and self-destruction.


[previewyoutube=bAjONRe68c8;full][/previewyoutube]
Double Sleep: The Hornets will be able to put two enemies to sleep, buying you critical time.


[previewyoutube=FJzpm5Tv8ec;full][/previewyoutube]
Wide Self Destruct: The range of the self-destruction attack will notably increase, enabling you to take out a wider array of enemies. However, this comes at the cost of a decrease in the damage dealt.


Thank you for joining us on this inside look at the Hornets' skills. As we continue to design and balance the units in Warkestra, we're excited to hear your feedback and see how these tactics enhance your gameplay experiences.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Artifacts Introduction #4 - Spear
notes.content:
Hello there,

Today, we're excited to introduce the final artifact: the Spear. 

The Spear, similar to the Glove, does not have any combos but can pierce through enemies when charged. Just like the Glove, your movement speed decreases while charging the Spear.

[previewyoutube=Nofk845NnRU;full][/previewyoutube]
The Spear pairs excellently with Hornets. The more Hornets you have attacking alongside the Spear, the faster you can trigger its special effect: the lightning storm.

[previewyoutube=XVtGyZpYdp8;full][/previewyoutube]
We hope you find the Spear a thrilling addition to your Warkestra arsenal. Remember that understanding the unique attributes and synergies of each weapon makes you not just a player, but a strategist. With these valuable insights, you are well-positioned to master the dynamic battlescape and lead your army to stunning victories.

Now, time to unleash the power of your Spear and create some real electrical storms on the battlefield! Keep up the spirit, and let the adventures continue in the world of Warkestra.

notes.title: Troop Enhancement #3 - Golem
notes.content:
Hi fellow gamers,

Today, we will look into the passive skills of the mighty Golems in Warkestra. As expected, the Golems' passive abilities are primarily centered around defense.


Throw as Base Attack:

 The Golem's basic attack will change to a range throw. 
 While it compromises a bit on damage, it allows continuous ranged attacks, thus keeping enemies at bay.

Small Projection Shield:

 The Golem's shield can block all incoming small projectiles, fortifying its defense and providing crucial protection in battle.

Mud Transform:

 The Golems lose their invulnerability but in exchange, they gain a 'Mud' effect that slows down the movement speed of all surrounding enemies. 
 This skill is particularly effective when trying to create some space between your Golems and rushing attackers.

[previewyoutube=2-DAmuezW-E;full][/previewyoutube]
Thank you for joining us as we delve deeper into the strategies and abilities of our Golem units. We are enthusiastic to hear how these tweaks to our beloved Golems enhance your gameplay and modify your tactics. As we continue to design and optimize Warkestra, stay tuned for more insights and updates. 

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Artifacts Introduction #3 - Glove
notes.content:
Hello there,

Today we are thrilled to present you with the third and unique mid-range attack artifact: the Glove.

The Glove operates without any combo sequence but instead fires projectiles immediately. You can also charge it by holding down the left mouse button. When fully charged, you can release a massive four-shot attack that can deal significant damage to enemies. However, be aware that your movement speed decreases during charging.

[previewyoutube=eM8B--ZeN0k;full][/previewyoutube]

The Glove pairs well with Archers. The more Archers attack, the quicker you can stack and trigger its unique effect: the slow-down debuff.

[previewyoutube=GY6phTeHItA;full][/previewyoutube]

Remember, honing your skills and understanding how various game elements interact is key to becoming a triumphant strategist in the world of Warkestra. With the Glove artifact and your team of Archers, you're set to slow down the opposition and lead your troops to victory.

We're excited to see you put these lessons into action in the gaming arena. As you continue to progress and refine your strategies, we’re here cheering for you. Adventure onwards and share your victories with us!

notes.title: Troop Enhancement #2 - Archers
notes.content:
Greetings Commanders,

Today, let's delve into the particular passive skills of one of our most invaluable troops - the Archers. Designed to deliver increased damage under specific circumstances, these skills can be the game-changers in the heat of battle.

[previewyoutube=RkY49KgZQaM;full][/previewyoutube]
Standing Shot

 This skill boosts the Archers' base damage when they attack while standing still.
 The arrows light up with a red hue.

Charged Shot

 Think quality over quantity - while the attack speed might slow down, the damage of the Archers' base attack increases significantly.
 The Archers shoot bigger arrows.

[previewyoutube=TeEDjCW777Y;full][/previewyoutube]
Focused Rapid Shot

 This transforms your Archer's Rapid Shot: while only one arrow is fired, the attack's damage gets a substantial upgrade.

Elite Archer

 If the number of Archers in your unit are fewer than four, the overall abilities of the Archers, including movement speed, are enhanced.


This overview of the Archers' passive skills should equip you with the knowledge to employ them more strategically in your future battles. Remember, mastering these skills and knowing when to utilize them could very well turn the tide of battle in your favor.

May your battles be thrilling and victories sweet! Keep sharing your feedback and game experiences, and stay tuned for more updates.

Until our next deep dive, happy gaming!

notes.title: Artifacts Introduction #2 - Sword
notes.content:
Hello there,

Today, I'm excited to introduce to you the second artifact a player can equip: the Sword.

The Sword artifact operates on a 3-step combo. If the first two attack is connected as a combo, the last attack's speed will increase.

Moreover, the Sword pairs quite well with the Warriors. The more Warriors attack, the quicker you can stack, and trigger its special effect: a widespread continuous damage debuff.

[previewyoutube=EkQ8qawri9A;full][/previewyoutube]
We hope this guide gives you a deeper insight into the unique dynamics of the Sword artifact and its effective combination with Warriors. Remember, discovering and mastering these relationships between artifacts and different elements within the game is part of your journey to becoming the ultimate strategist.

Continue forging ahead with your warriors. May your battles prove victorious and your adventures thrilling in the world of Warkestra.

notes.title: Voice recognition and Intent analysis technology #3
notes.content:
Hello there,

Today, I would like to talk about advanced voice commands.

In Warkestra, you can use attack commands in various ways. Here are some methods to make full use of these features.

These are commands to specify the attack direction. Remember, all direction commands are based on the player's point of view, guiding your forces.
[previewyoutube=fM0PUiNqcCM;full][/previewyoutube]
In particular, attacking from behind can help you reap great efficiency if the Back Attack skill is unlocked.

You can also command to attack while rotating around a target. You can use the commands "Clockwise" and "Counterclockwise."

By using all the voice command techniques, you are sure to be victorious in clearing all stages of 'Warkestra'!

notes.title: Game Guide #4 - Boss Fight
notes.content:
Greetings, gamers!

Today, we are going to discuss the skills used by the Guardian, the final content of the demo we launched.

The Guardian has three major attack moves other than the base attack. Check out the list below to understand the attack patterns and some recommended commands to counter the attacks.


Base attack

 The Guardian targets the left, right, and center randomly, attacking twice.
 Recommended voice commands: "Attack from left", "Attack from right", "Come here", "Watch out"
 Recommended consumable artifact: Defensive Field

[previewyoutube=FPy3Y6Je3fU;full][/previewyoutube]

Big jump

 The Guardian performs a high jump slamming attack.
 Recommended voice commands: "Come here", "Watch out", "Follow me"
 Recommended consumable artifact: Recovery Field

[previewyoutube=KprilIiPgRM;full][/previewyoutube]

3 Stones Throw

 The Guardian attacks by throwing three massive stones.
 Recommended voice commands: "Watch out", "Come here", "Follow me"
 Recommended consumable artifact: Defensive Field

[previewyoutube=Yan0T1A4zUM;full][/previewyoutube]

3 Times dash

 The Guardian performs a random-direction dash attack three times.
 The Guardian can be stunned by the Golem's "Transform" skill or the Hornet's "Self-destruction" skill.
 Recommended voice commands: "Transform", "Self-destruction"
 Recommended consumable artifact: Ice Field, Defensive Field

[previewyoutube=Q1-QeBA9kJE;full][/previewyoutube]

Remember that mastering these techniques and commands is key to victory. 
Game on, and may the odds be forever in your favor.

notes.title: Game Guide #3 - Efficient Voice Command Tips
notes.content:
Hello Commanders.

Today, I plan to explain a method that can help you conduct battles more efficiently using voice commands.

This is a feature that allows you to specify the number of minions using a skill. Each of the active skills of your troops can be used by specifying the number of minions who can make use of them.

As each type of troop has unique skills, you do not need to specify who needs to use the skill.

You can simplify the command like this: 


Warrior (Skill: Jump Strike, Taunt)

 If you want two Warriors to use jump strike to Archers, you can say, "Two jump to Archers" 
 To get only one Warrior to taunt, say, "One taunt!"

[previewyoutube=HVzEoQ-fFwU;full][/previewyoutube]

Archer (Skill: Ice Arrow)

 "Two Archers use ice arrow to Warriors" can be shortened to "Two ice to Warriors"

[previewyoutube=LoBGwhwTJOM;full][/previewyoutube]

Golem (Skill: Throw, Shield, Transform)

 Say "Four, throw to Archers." to get four Golems to use the throw skill to Archers.
 "One shield." will command one Golem to use the shield skill.
 Same with transform. Simply say, "Two transform."

[previewyoutube=A3ke-F4_7vo;full][/previewyoutube]

Hornet (Skill: Self-destruction, Sleep)

 The Hornet's Self-destruction skill is the only skill that requires specifying the number of minions. Since the Hornets disappear after using the Self-desctruction skill, specifying a number is mandatory to prevent accidents. Try saying, "One self-destruction to Archers."
 For the Sleep skill, you can say, "One sleep to warrior."

[previewyoutube=0IipOxSi5Ak;full][/previewyoutube]

I hope these tips enhance your battle strategies and help you effectively use voice commands. Practice these simplified versions and see how they can change the tide of battle in your favor.

Until next time, happy gaming!

Today, I'm going to introduce the passive skills of the Warkestra's minions for the first time. Slowing Jump Strike
Enemies' movement speed will decrease when affected by the Jump Strike skill.

notes.title: Skill Command Introduction #2
notes.content:
Welcome back!

Today, we continue with part two of our skill command introduction. We're going to explore the higher-level minions, the Golem and the Hornet.

First up, meet the Golem. This minion excels in defense, using its powerful Shield skill to protect allies. It can also Morph into a rock attaining invincibility through the Transform skill or hurl a rock to make a ranged attack with the Throw Stone skill. You can also trigger the Shield with various words that mean defense, like "Defense" or "Guard Area". Similarly, "Change" or "Polymorph" can activate the Transform skill and the Throw Stone skill can be activated by simply saying "Throw".

[previewyoutube=T8C9oQybO5U;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=Q4V49qRbRls;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=CSXai3rXzeA;full][/previewyoutube]
Next, we've got the Hornet, an airborne unit immune to ground-based melee attacks. This sly minion boasts the Sleep skill, which puts opponents to sleep, the Homing Missile skill which operates automatically, and the Self-Destruction skill, delivering massive damage at the cost of its own existence.

[previewyoutube=7qO6qOCiF2w;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=86dipY6w2V0;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=lG-kNEVFQjk;full][/previewyoutube]

Brace for some serious action!

notes.content:
Good day, gamers!

Let's talk about artifacts that players can equip and use in Warkestra. 

Let's kick this off with the Mace! As you navigate through the stages, you can discover these artifacts in treasure chests. You can only equip one weapon-type artifact at a time, so when a new one appears, choose wisely based on your troop composition and your own playstyle preferences.

The Mace comes with a basic 2-hit combo attack and also offers an additional jump slam attack.

notes.title: Voice recognition and Intent analysis technology #2
notes.content:
Hello there!

Today, we're going to delve into some advanced voice commands. First up is the "Come here" command. You could also use other phrases with the same meaning like "Over here".

This command brings your minions to where your player stands, and once they arrive, they assume a defensive stance, ready to automatically attack any viable enemies. You can also use this command selectively for specific types of troops.

[previewyoutube=Bi1UwLR5g2A;full][/previewyoutube]

Next up is the "Help me!" command. In the heat of the battlefield, nothing is off-limits, including the player character coming under direct attack. That's when you call out "Help me!", and all your minions will spring into action to deal with the situation as best as they can.

[previewyoutube=c3tXYL7JUyc;full][/previewyoutube]

Lastly, we have "Watch out!", perfect for when enemies use area attacks to take on numerous minions at once. This is when danger zones, indicated in red, appear. On cue with your "Watch out!" command, your minions realize the jeopardy they are in and swiftly evade these danger zones. In addition to "Watch out", you can also use commands like "Avoid" or "Evade".

[previewyoutube=fXiN7bB8qlc;full][/previewyoutube]

Ready to upscale your game with these advanced voice commands? 

Let's conquer the battlefield together!

notes.title: Skill Command Introduction #1

Our trusty warrior possesses two impressive skills: the Jump Strike capable of powerfully attacking an area, and the Taunt skill which effectively draws the enemy's attention. You can also launch the Jump Strike with a short command like "Jump", and trigger the Taunt function by saying "Provoke".

This nimble minion comes equipped with the Ice Arrow skill that slows down the adversary's movement and the Rapid Arrow, which comes firing even without specific commands. The neat thing about the Ice Arrow skill? You can also trigger it with the command "Slow".

[previewyoutube=KUUFlNsoxtA;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=2joI7TyoQ54;full][/previewyoutube]

Ready to add these skills to your arsenal?

notes.title: Voice recognition and Intent analysis technology #1
